p9_b4.ocr: Vessel B, with 310 days operated and an 80% utilization rate, accrued $14M in revenue, $4.5M in operating costs, $9.5M net income, $2.5M CAPEX, $3M OPEX, 6 years average age, and 1,150 MT fuel consumed. Vessel D had 325 days of operation, 75% utilization, with $13M revenue, $5.5M operating costs, $7.5M net income, $2M CAPEX, $2.8M OPEX, an average of 8 years, and 1,300 MT fuel.

p9_b5.ocr: Vessel E operated for 300 days at 88% utilization, yielding $15.5M revenue, $5.2M operating costs, $10.3M net income, $2.3M CAPEX, $3.2M OPEX, average age of 3 years, and 1,250 MT fuel. Additionally, the Drydocking and Maintenance Schedule highlights Vessel 1 with drydock costs of $500K scheduled for Q1 2024, routine maintenance for 30 days, expected revenue of $1M; Vessel 2 with $750K drydock costs in Q2 2024 for emergency maintenance for 45 days, yielding $800K; Vessel 3 with $600K in drydock costs for routine maintenance in Q3 2024 over 25 days, expecting $900K; and Vessel 4, with $450K drydock costs in Q4 2024 for routine maintenance over 20 days, anticipated at $1.2M. The total drydock costs sum to $2.35M, with an average duration of 30 days and total revenue estimated at $3.9M.
